sources.subject: Flock FreeForm
sources.finding: Public natural-language search workflow; adopted only the query-to-review pattern.

sources.subject: Genetec Investigation
sources.finding: Time/camera constrained investigation and result review.

sources.subject: Axis Scene Metadata
sources.finding: Structured metadata supports filterable forensic workflows.

sources.subject: BriefCam
sources.finding: Search/review/export workflow patterns; no internal algorithm inferred.

sources.subject: Avigilon Appearance Search
sources.finding: Candidate review across recorded video; this build uses uncertainty-first candidate language.

sources.subject: Verkada History Search
sources.finding: People/vehicle history and temporal review patterns.

sources.subject: Milestone evidence workflow
sources.finding: Search, bookmark and evidence export patterns.

sources.subject: March Networks Command Client
sources.finding: Timeline investigation and case sharing patterns.

sources.subject: Bosch VCA
sources.finding: Rule-specific object, spatial and temporal evidence contracts.

sources.subject: Spot AI Cases
sources.finding: Case-based evidence organization and sharing workflow.

sources.subject: NVIDIA VSS
sources.finding: Video search/summarization reference architecture; not copied as browser internals.

sources.subject: OpenVINO MobileCLIP search
sources.finding: Open reference workflow for video sampling and text-image retrieval.

sources.subject: IndexedDB
sources.finding: Browser database basis and transactional limitations.

sources.subject: ONNX Runtime WebGPU
sources.finding: WebGPU acceleration is capability-dependent; WASM fallback remains required.

sources.subject: ByteTrack ECCV 2022
sources.finding: Low-confidence detections can recover occluded tracklets; adopted as a second-stage association pattern, not an identity claim.

sources.subject: CVAT annotation editor
sources.finding: Occlusion, visibility, filtering, and z-order are first-class annotation concerns; informed collision-aware label placement and layered rendering.

sources.subject: FiftyOne detection evaluation
sources.finding: Confidence filtering and object-patch views reduce clutter; informed compact confidence labels and the separate evidence view.

sources.subject: Transformers.js SegFormer
sources.finding: Official browser adapter uses image-segmentation; water-class masks are converted to localized regions.

sources.subject: Transformers.js YOLOv8 Pose
sources.finding: Model requires AutoModel and AutoProcessor rather than a pipeline; output exposes 17 keypoints for geometry-based fall candidates.
